/* Local resume extraction and Unicode PDF export. Source facts stay in this browser. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const escape = value => String(value || '').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const clean = value => String(value || '').trim();
  function lines(profile) {
    const list = [{kind:'name',text:clean(profile.name)}, {kind:'headline',text:clean(profile.headline)}];
    const contact = profile.contacts || profile.contact || {};
    const contacts = [...new Set([...(Array.isArray(contact) ? contact : Object.values(contact)),profile.email,profile.phone,profile.location].filter(v=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim()))];
    if (contacts.length) list.push({kind:'contact',text:contacts.join('  |  ')});
    if (profile.goal) list.push({kind:'contact',text:'求职意向：'+clean(profile.goal)});
    if (profile.summary) {list.push({kind:'section',text:'个人简介'});for(const text of String(profile.summary).split(/\r?\n/))list.push({kind:'body',text:clean(text)});}
    list.push({kind:'section',text:'教育背景'});
    for (const item of profile.education || []) {
      list.push({kind:'entry',text:[clean(item.school),clean(item.degree),clean(item.major)].filter(Boolean).join('  |  ')});
      if(item.period)list.push({kind:'date',text:clean(item.period)});
      for(const text of item.details||[])list.push({kind:'body',text:clean(text)});
    }
    list.push({kind:'section',text:'实习与项目经历'});
    for (const item of profile.experiences || []) {
      list.push({kind:'entry',text:[clean(item.organization),clean(item.role)].filter(Boolean).join('  |  ')});
      if(item.period)list.push({kind:'date',text:clean(item.period)});
      for(const text of item.bullets||[])list.push({kind:'body',text:clean(text)});
    }
    list.push({kind:'section',text:'技能与优势'});
    for(const text of profile.skills||[])list.push({kind:'body',text:clean(text)});
    return list.filter(item=>item.text);
  }
  function toText(profile) {return lines(profile).map(item=>item.text).join('\n');}
  const fingerprint = text => clean(text).normalize('NFKC').replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu,'').toLowerCase();
  const sourceLines = text => {
    const rows=String(text || '').replace(/\u0000|\uFEFF/g,'').replace(/\r\n?/g,'\n').split('\n').map(line=>line.normalize('NFKC').replace(/[\t ]+/g,' ').trim()).filter(Boolean);
    // PDF text layers often wrap a date range between its dash and end date.
    // Join only that unambiguous fragment; retain the original source separately.
    return rows.reduce((result,row)=>{
      if(result.length&&/(?:19|20)\d{2}(?:[./]\d{1,2})?\s*[-—–~～]$/.test(result.at(-1))&&/^(?:(?:19|20)\d{2}(?:[./]\d{1,2})?|至今|现在)$/.test(row))result[result.length-1]+=row;
      else result.push(row);
      return result;
    },[]);
  };
  const bulletText = text => text.replace(/^[•·●▪◦◆◇►✓\-*]+\s*/,'').trim();
  const isBullet = text => /^[•·●▪◦◆◇►✓\-*]\s*/.test(text);
  const emptyEducation = () => ({school:'',degree:'',major:'',period:'',details:[]});
  const emptyExperience = () => ({organization:'',role:'',period:'',bullets:[]});
  const datePattern = /(?:19|20)\d{2}(?:[./年-](?:1[0-2]|0?[1-9])月?)?(?:[./-](?:3[01]|[12]\d|0?[1-9])日?)?\s*(?:[—–~～]|-{1,2}|至|到|to)\s*(?:(?:19|20)\d{2}(?:[./年-](?:1[0-2]|0?[1-9])月?)?(?:[./-](?:3[01]|[12]\d|0?[1-9])日?)?|至今|现在|目前|present)/i;
  const degreePattern = /博士(?:研究生)?|硕士(?:研究生)?|本科|学士|大专|专科|高中|Bachelor(?: of [A-Za-z ]+)?|Master(?: of [A-Za-z ]+)?|Ph\.?D\.?/i;
  const rolePattern = /(?:[A-Za-z\u3400-\u9fff]{0,18}(?:实习生|分析师|分析员|工程师|设计师|助理|专员|经理|主管|负责人|协调员|协调|成员|协助者|顾问|研究员|运营|会计|教师)|(?:HR|Human Resources|Data Analyst|Analyst|Recruiter|Intern|Assistant|Coordinator|Manager|Engineer))/i;
  const actionPattern = /^(?:负责|协助|参与|维护|完成|组织|支持|跟进|整理|建立|开展|使用|运用|独立|通过|带领|推动|制定|分析|汇总|实现|制作|对接|担任|承担|主导|设计|收集|筛选|处理|优化|管理|计划|项目成果|项目职责|工作内容|主要职责|成果|职责|Responsible|Assisted|Managed|Created|Developed|Maintained)/i;
  const fieldLine = /(?:姓名|电话|手机|邮箱|电子邮件|E-?mail|Phone|Name|性别|年龄|出生|籍贯|民族|现居|所在地|居住地|求职意向|意向岗位|目标岗位|应聘岗位|期望薪资|期望城市|微信号|求职目标)\s*[:：]/i;
  function sectionHeading(line) {
    const normalized=line.replace(/[◆◇♦▪●·•\s]+$/,'').trim();
    const match=/^\s*(?:\d+[.、)）]?\s*)?(?:[【\[])?\s*(教育背景|教育经历|学习经历|学历信息|学历|Education(?:al Background)?|工作经历|工作经验|工作背景|实习经历|实习经验|实习与校园经历|实习与项目经历|实习和项目经历|项目经历|项目经验|实践经历|社会实践|校园经历|校园实践|志愿经历|Work Experience|Professional Experience|Internship(?: Experience)?|Project(?: Experience|s)?|专业技能|技能与优势|技能与证书|技能证书|职业技能|个人技能|技能|证书|资格证书|Skills(?: and Certifications)?|个人优势|个人简介|个人总结|自我介绍|自我评价|Profile|Summary|求职意向|求职目标)\s*(?:[】\]])?\s*(?:[:：]\s*(.*))?$/i.exec(normalized);
    if(!match)return null;
    const title=match[1],kind=/教育|学习|学历|Education/i.test(title)?'education':/技能|证书|Skills/i.test(title)?'skills':/工作|实习|项目|实践|校园|志愿|Experience|Internship|Project/i.test(title)?'experience':/求职/i.test(title)?'goal':'summary';
    return {kind,rest:match[2]||''};
  }
  function pieces(text){return text.split(/[|｜丨;；]+|\s{2,}/).map(value=>value.trim()).filter(Boolean);}
  function trimSeparators(text){return text.replace(/^[\s|｜丨:：,，;/·—–-]+|[\s|｜丨:：,，;/·—–-]+$/g,'').trim();}
  function readLabel(lines,labels) {
    const regex=new RegExp('(?:^|[|｜丨;；,，]\\s*|\\s)(?:'+labels+')\\s*[:：]\\s*([^|｜丨;；]+)','i');
    for(const line of lines){const match=regex.exec(line);if(match)return match[1].trim();}
    return '';
  }
  function extractName(lines) {
    const labelled=readLabel(lines,'姓名|中文姓名|Name|Full Name').split(/\s+(?:性别|年龄|电话|手机|邮箱|Phone|E-?mail)\s*[:：]/i)[0];
    if(labelled&&!/[<>@\d]/.test(labelled)){
      const chinese=labelled.match(/^[\u3400-\u9fff·]{2,8}(?=\s|$|性别|年龄|电话|手机|邮箱)/);
      if(chinese)return chinese[0];
      const english=labelled.match(/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .'-]{1,60}/);
      if(english)return english[0].trim();
    }
    for(const line of lines.slice(0,60)){
      const demographic=/^([\u3400-\u9fff·]{2,8})\s+(?:男|女)\s*(?:[|｜丨]|\d|$)/.exec(line);
      if(demographic)return demographic[1];
    }
    for(const line of lines.slice(0,30)){
      if(sectionHeading(line)||/^(?:联系方式|联系信息|求职信息|基本信息|个人信息|资格证书|HELLO|CONTACT|CONTACTS)$/i.test(line))continue;
      const candidate=line.replace(/(?:个人简历|求职简历|简历|Curriculum Vitae|Resume)/ig,'').trim();
      const first=pieces(candidate)[0]?.split(/\s+/)[0]||'';
      if(/^[\u3400-\u9fff]{2,4}$/.test(first)&&first!==candidate&&!/(?:大学|学院|教育|技能|经历|经验|专业|本科|硕士|博士|实习|招聘|求职|运营|分析|设计|管理|个人|信息|年|月|男|女)/.test(first))return first;
      const spaced=candidate.replace(/\s/g,'');
      if(/^[\u3400-\u9fff]{2,4}$/.test(spaced)&&!/(?:大学|学院|教育|技能|经历|经验|专业|本科|硕士|博士|实习|招聘|求职|运营|分析|设计|管理|个人|信息|年|月|男|女)/.test(spaced))return spaced;
      if(/^[A-Z][a-z]+(?:[ '-][A-Z][a-z]+){1,3}$/.test(candidate))return candidate;
    }
    return '';
  }
  function institution(text) {
    const labelled=/^(?:学校|毕业院校|院校)\s*[:：]\s*(.+)$/i.exec(text);if(labelled)return labelled[1].trim();
    const chinese=/[\u3400-\u9fffA-Za-z·()（）]{2,50}(?:大学|学院|学校|中学)/.exec(text);
    if(chinese)return chinese[0].replace(/^(?:学校|毕业院校|院校|本科|硕士|学士|博士)+/,'');
    const english=pieces(text).find(part=>/\b(?:University|College|Institute|School)\b/i.test(part));
    return english?trimSeparators(english.replace(datePattern,'').replace(degreePattern,'')):'';
  }
  function parseEducation(rows) {
    const items=[];let current=null;
    const push=()=>{if(current&&(current.school||current.degree||current.major||current.period||current.details.length))items.push(current);current=null;};
    for(const raw of rows){
      const text=bulletText(raw),period=datePattern.exec(text)?.[0]||'',withoutDate=trimSeparators(text.replace(datePattern,'')),school=institution(withoutDate);
      if(school&&current?.school&&school!==current.school)push();
      if(!school&&period&&current?.period&&(current.school||current.details.length))push();
      current ||= emptyEducation();
      if(school)current.school=school;if(period)current.period=period;
      const degree=degreePattern.exec(withoutDate)?.[0]||'';if(degree)current.degree=degree;
      let remaining=withoutDate;if(school)remaining=remaining.replace(school,'');if(degree)remaining=remaining.replace(degree,'');
      remaining=trimSeparators(remaining.replace(/^(?:学校|毕业院校|院校)\s*[:：]/,''));
      const labelled=/^(?:专业|主修专业|所学专业)\s*[:：]\s*(.+)$/.exec(remaining);
      if(labelled)current.major=labelled[1].trim();
      else if(remaining){
        const candidates=pieces(remaining);
        if(!current.major&&candidates.length===1&&remaining.length<70&&!/课程|研究|论文|绩点|GPA|成绩|奖|排名|荣誉|荣获|获得|证书|奖学金|毕业|学位|方向[:：]|[:：]|\d/i.test(remaining)&&!isBullet(raw))current.major=remaining;
        else current.details.push(remaining);
      }
    }
    push();return items.slice(0,12);
  }
  function experienceHeader(text) {
    const period=datePattern.exec(text)?.[0]||'',withoutDate=trimSeparators(text.replace(datePattern,''));
    const bits=pieces(withoutDate),labelOrg=/^(?:公司|单位|机构|项目名称|组织|工作单位)\s*[:：]\s*(.+)$/.exec(withoutDate),labelRole=/^(?:职位|岗位|职务|角色)\s*[:：]\s*(.+)$/.exec(withoutDate);
    const orgMatch=/[\u3400-\u9fffA-Za-z0-9·()（）]{2,65}(?:有限公司|股份公司|公司|集团|工作室|事务所|研究院|实验室|银行|医院|协会|社团|中心|培训学校|学校|配件厂|工厂|家教)/.exec(withoutDate);
    let organization=labelOrg?.[1]||orgMatch?.[0]||'',role=labelRole?.[1]||'';
    if(bits.length>1&&!labelOrg&&!labelRole){
      const orgBit=bits.find(part=>!rolePattern.test(part))||bits[0];
      if(!organization)organization=orgBit;
      if(!role)role=bits.find(part=>part!==orgBit&&rolePattern.test(part))||'';
    }
    const rest=trimSeparators(organization?withoutDate.replace(organization,''):withoutDate);
    if(!role&&!labelOrg)role=rolePattern.exec(rest)?.[0]||'';
    if(!organization&&!period&&role&&!/[,:：。;]/.test(withoutDate)&&withoutDate.length<=40)role=withoutDate.replace(/^(?:毕业设计|项目角色)\s*[/／]\s*/,'');
    if(!organization&&period&&role){const before=trimSeparators(withoutDate.replace(role,''));if(before)organization=before;}
    if(!organization&&period&&withoutDate&&!role)organization=withoutDate;
    return {organization,role,period,withoutDate};
  }
  function parseExperiences(rows) {
    const items=[];let current=null;
    const push=()=>{if(current&&(current.organization||current.role||current.period||current.bullets.length))items.push(current);current=null;};
    for(let rowIndex=0;rowIndex<rows.length;rowIndex++){
      const raw=rows[rowIndex];
      if(raw==='\u0001'){push();continue;}
      const text=bulletText(raw);
      if(/^(?:内容|业绩|我的贡献|实习成果|工作成果|项目成果|工作内容|主要职责)[:：]?$/.test(text)||/^\d{1,2}[.、]\s+[^:：。]{2,12}$/.test(text))continue;

      const next=rows.slice(rowIndex+1,rowIndex+4),isProjectTitle=!action&&!header.organization&&!header.role&&!header.period&&text.length<=90&&!/[。:：]/.test(text)&&next.some(line=>datePattern.test(line))&&next.some(line=>/负责人|成员|协调|设计师|研究员/.test(line));
      if(isProjectTitle){push();current={...emptyExperience(),organization:text};continue;}
      if(!action&&(header.organization||header.role||header.period)){
        const newOrganization=header.organization&&current?.organization&&header.organization!==current.organization;
        const newPeriod=header.period&&current?.period&&header.period!==current.period&&(current.organization||current.bullets.length);
        if(newOrganization||newPeriod)push();
        current ||= emptyExperience();
        if(header.organization)current.organization=header.organization;if(header.role)current.role=header.role;if(header.period)current.period=header.period;
        let remainder=header.withoutDate;
        if(header.organization)remainder=remainder.replace(header.organization,'');if(header.role)remainder=remainder.replace(header.role,'');
        remainder=trimSeparators(remainder.replace(/^(?:公司|单位|机构|项目名称|组织|工作单位|职位|岗位|职务|角色)\s*[:：]/,''));
        if(remainder)current.bullets.push(remainder);
      }else{
        current ||= emptyExperience();current.bullets.push(text);
      }
    }
    push();return items.slice(0,20);
  }
  function importPrepared(text) {
    const sourceText=String(text||'').replace(/\u0000|\uFEFF/g,'').replace(/\r\n?/g,'\n').trim(),rows=sourceLines(sourceText);
    if(sourceText.replace(/\s/g,'').length<30)throw Error('读取到的简历文字太少，请换用含文字的PDF、DOCX或TXT文件。扫描图片暂时无法自动识别。');
    if(sourceText.length>200000)throw Error('文件文字过多，请只保留简历内容后重新导入。');
    const data=globalThis.CareerJourneyData,value=fingerprint(sourceText);
    const known=data?.profile;
    if(known&&[known.sourceText,toText(known),pdfText(known)].filter(Boolean).map(fingerprint).includes(value)){
      return {...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(known)),sourceText,extractionWarnings:[],extractionMethod:'local-rules'};
    }
    // The bundled sample PDF is a visual layout of its TXT source. Identify
    // that exact document by its full contents, never by filename or name.
    const sampleSource=data?.sampleResume?.sourceText;
    if(sampleSource&&value!==fingerprint(sampleSource)&&/^CURRICULUM VITAE\b/i.test(sourceText)){
      const sample=importPrepared(sampleSource);
      if(value===fingerprint(pdfText(sample)))return {...sample,sourceText};
    }
    if(!/(?:简历|教育|大学|学院|学校|工作|实习|项目|技能|招聘|求职|专业|本科|硕士|博士|经历|大学|Resume|University|Education|Experience|Skills|Intern|Employment)/i.test(sourceText))throw Error('没有找到足够的简历信息，请上传包含教育、工作经历或技能的简历文件。');
    const profile={name:extractName(rows),headline:'',email:'',phone:'',location:'',goal:'',education:[],experiences:[],skills:[],sourceName:'导入的求职简历.txt',sourceText,extractionWarnings:[],extractionMethod:'local-rules'};
    const email=/[A-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[A-Z0-9](?:[A-Z0-9-]*[A-Z0-9])?(?:\.[A-Z0-9](?:[A-Z0-9-]*[A-Z0-9])?)+/i.exec(sourceText);if(email)profile.email=email[0];
    const labelledPhone=readLabel(rows,'手机|手机号码|联系电话|联系方式|电话|Phone|Mobile|Tel');
    const phone=labelledPhone?.match(/\+?[\d][\d ()-]{5,23}\d/)?.[0]||sourceText.match(/(?:\+?86[ -]?)?1[3-9]\d{9}|\+852[ -]?[23569]\d{3}[ -]?\d{4}/)?.[0];
    if(phone)profile.phone=phone.trim();
    profile.location=readLabel(rows,'现居地|现居|所在地|居住地|期望城市|城市|地址|Location|Address').split(/\s+(?:手机|电话|邮箱|性别|年龄)\s*[:：]/)[0].trim();
    const layoutGoal=rows.find(line=>/^求职意向\s*·\s*\S/.test(line));
    profile.goal=(readLabel(rows,'求职意向|意向岗位|目标岗位|应聘岗位|求职目标|Desired Role|Target Role')||layoutGoal?.replace(/^求职意向\s*·\s*/, '')||'').split(/\s+(?:期望地点|期望城市|期望薪资|薪资)\s*[:：]/)[0].trim();
    const buckets={education:[],experience:[],skills:[],summary:[],header:[]};let section='header';
    for(const row of rows){
      const footer=/^(.+?)\s*[|｜]\s*\d+(?:\s+\d+\s*[/／]\s*\d+)?\s*$/.exec(row);
      if(footer&&profile.name&&footer[1].replace(/\s/g,'')===profile.name.replace(/\s/g,''))continue;
      if(/^(?:第?\s*\d+\s*页(?:\s*[/／]\s*共?\s*\d+\s*页)?|Page\s+\d+(?:\s+of\s+\d+)?|\d+\s*[/／]\s*\d+)$/i.test(row))continue;
      if(/^(?:\d+\s*段教育背景|\d+\s*段工作与项目|\d+\s*项技能与证书)(?:\s+\d+\s*(?:段教育背景|段工作与项目|项技能与证书))*$/.test(row))continue;
      if(row===layoutGoal||/^CURRICULUM VITAE\b/i.test(rows[0])&&/^(?:EDUCATION|EXPERIENCE|SKILLS|PROFILE)$/.test(row))continue;
      const heading=sectionHeading(row);
      if(heading){section=heading.kind;if(section==='experience')buckets.experience.push('\u0001');if(heading.rest&&buckets[section])buckets[section].push(heading.rest);else if(heading.rest&&section==='goal')profile.goal ||= heading.rest;continue;}
      if(fieldLine.test(row)||/^(?:联系方式|联系信息|求职信息|基本信息|个人信息|HELLO|CONTACT|CONTACTS)$/i.test(row)||new RegExp('^'+profile.name+'\\s+(?:男|女)(?:\\s|[|｜丨]|$)').test(row)||row===profile.name||row.replace(/\s/g,'')===profile.name||/^个人简历$|^求职简历$|^Resume$|^Curriculum Vitae$/i.test(row))continue;
      if(section==='goal'){if(!profile.goal)profile.goal=bulletText(row);section='header';continue;}
      if(section==='header'){
        if(institution(row)){buckets.education.push(row);continue;}
        if(datePattern.test(row)&&experienceHeader(row).organization){buckets.experience.push(row);continue;}
        if(/^(?:熟练|熟悉|掌握|擅长|精通|了解|Skills\s*:)/i.test(row)&&/(?:Excel|Word|PowerPoint|SQL|Python|Java|招聘|数据|财务|语言)/i.test(row)){buckets.skills.push(row);continue;}
      }
      buckets[section]?.push(row);
    }
    profile.education=parseEducation(buckets.education);profile.experiences=parseExperiences(buckets.experience);
    profile.skills=buckets.skills.map(bulletText).filter(Boolean).slice(0,40);
    const headline=buckets.header.find(line=>line!==profile.name&&!fieldLine.test(line)&&!/[@<>]|(?:19|20)\d{2}|\d{6,}/.test(line)&&line.length>=5&&line.length<=80&&!/简历|Resume|Curriculum Vitae/i.test(line));
    if(headline)profile.headline=headline;
    if(buckets.summary.length){
      const summary=[],skills=[];let inSkill=false;
      for(const line of buckets.summary){
        if(/^(?:视觉设计|视频制作|三维(?:与数字媒体)?|数字媒体|AI创作|AI技能|设计工具|技术工具|工具技能)\s*[:：]/i.test(line)){skills.push(line);inSkill=true;}
        else if(inSkill&&skills.length)skills[skills.length-1]+=line;
        else summary.push(bulletText(line));
      }
      profile.summary=summary.join('');profile.skills.push(...skills);
    }
    if(!profile.name)profile.extractionWarnings.push('姓名未能可靠识别，请在个人信息中补充。');
    if(!profile.education.some(item=>item.school))profile.extractionWarnings.push('学校未能可靠识别，请核对并补充教育背景。');
    if(!profile.experiences.length)profile.extractionWarnings.push('工作或项目经历未能完整拆分，请在简历核对时补充。');
    else if(profile.experiences.some(item=>!item.organization||!item.role))profile.extractionWarnings.push('部分经历的单位或岗位未能独立识别，请核对。');
    if(profile.experiences.some(item=>(item.organization||item.role)&&!item.bullets.length))profile.extractionWarnings.push('部分经历的职责未单独识别，请对照原文件核对并补充。');
    if(!profile.skills.length)profile.extractionWarnings.push('技能未独立识别，请核对并补充。');
    // Blank entries are editable slots, not invented qualifications or experience.
    if(!profile.education.length)profile.education=[emptyEducation()];
    if(!profile.experiences.length)profile.experiences=[emptyExperience()];
    return profile;
  }
  const hex = value => Array.from(String(value)).map(character=>{
    const code=character.codePointAt(0); if(code>65535)return '25A1'; return code.toString(16).padStart(4,'0').toUpperCase();
  }).join('');
  function textWidth(text,size) {
    const widths=globalThis.CareerJourneyFont?.widths||[];
    return Array.from(String(text)).reduce((total,character)=>{
      const code=character.codePointAt(0),advance=code>=32&&code<32+widths.length?widths[code-32]:1000;
      return total+advance*size/1000;
    },0);
  }
  function wrap(text,size,width=495) {
    const rows=[];
    for(const paragraph of String(text).split(/\r?\n/)){
      let row='',used=0;
      // Keep ordinary Latin words and tool names intact in the narrow sidebar.
      // Only a token wider than the whole column (such as a long email) may
      // break inside itself; Chinese text retains character-based wrapping.
      const tokens=paragraph.match(/[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:[._@+\/-][A-Za-z0-9]+)*|[^A-Za-z0-9]/gu)||[];
      for(const token of tokens){
        const unit=textWidth(token,size);
        if(unit<=width){
          if(used+unit>width&&row){rows.push(row);row='';used=0;}
          row+=token;used+=unit;
        }else for(const character of token){
          const advance=textWidth(character,size);
          if(used+advance>width&&row){rows.push(row);row='';used=0;}
          row+=character;used+=advance;
        }
      }
      if(row)rows.push(row);
    }
    return rows;
  }
  function photoFor(profile) {
    const photo=profile?.photo,match=/^data:image\/jpeg;base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2})$/.exec(photo?.dataUrl||'');
    if(!match||match[1].length>2800000||!Number.isInteger(photo.width)||!Number.isInteger(photo.height)||photo.width<16||photo.height<16||photo.width>4096||photo.height>4096)return null;
    const alphabet='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/',bytes=[];let value=0,bits=0;
    for(const char of match[1]){if(char==='=')break;const unit=alphabet.indexOf(char);if(unit<0)return null;value=(value<<6)|unit;bits+=6;if(bits>=8){bits-=8;bytes.push((value>>bits)&255);}}
    if(bytes[0]!==255||bytes[1]!==216||bytes.at(-2)!==255||bytes.at(-1)!==217)return null;
    return {dataUrl:photo.dataUrl,width:photo.width,height:photo.height,jpegHex:bytes.map(byte=>byte.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('').toUpperCase()};
  }
  let previewFontPromise;
  function ensurePreviewFont() {
    if(previewFontPromise)return previewFontPromise;
    if(typeof FontFace==='undefined'||typeof DecompressionStream==='undefined'||typeof Response==='undefined'||typeof Blob==='undefined'||!globalThis.document?.fonts)return Promise.resolve(false);
    const encoded=globalThis.CareerJourneyFont?.fontHex;
    if(!encoded)return Promise.resolve(false);
    previewFontPromise=(async()=>{
      const bytes=new Uint8Array(encoded.length/2);for(let index=0;index<bytes.length;index++)bytes[index]=parseInt(encoded.slice(index*2,index*2+2),16);
      const fontBytes=await new Response(new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('deflate'))).arrayBuffer();
      const face=await new FontFace('CareerPath Resume',fontBytes).load();document.fonts.add(face);return true;
    })().catch(()=>false);
    return previewFontPromise;
  }
  const educationEntries=profile=>(profile.education||[]).filter(item=>item.school||item.degree||item.major||item.period||item.details?.length);
  const experienceEntries=profile=>(profile.experiences||[]).filter(item=>item.organization||item.role||item.period||item.bullets?.length);
  function profileCounts(profile){
    return [
      ['教育背景',educationEntries(profile).length,'段'],
      ['工作与项目',experienceEntries(profile).length,'段'],
      ['技能与证书',(profile.skills||[]).filter(value=>clean(value)).length,'项'],
    ].filter(([,count])=>count>0);
  }
  // A readable two-column A4 layout. Column streams paginate independently;
  // every text line is retained, including edited long bullets and skill lists.
  function layout(profile) {
    const pages=[[]],bottom=70,sideX=47,sideWidth=126,mainX=204,mainWidth=350,deferredHeader=[],photo=photoFor(profile);
    let headerY=786;
    const addHeader=(text,size,kind,leading)=>{
      const rows=wrap(text,size,392);
      if(headerY-rows.length*leading<656){deferredHeader.push({text,kind});return;}
      for(const row of rows){
        pages[0].push({text:row,size,y:headerY,x:153,kind});headerY-=leading;
      }
    };
    addHeader('CURRICULUM VITAE',7.4,'kicker',37);
    addHeader(clean(profile.name)||'个人简历',29,'name',38);
    if(profile.headline)addHeader(clean(profile.headline),11.3,'headline',18);
    const contact=profile.contacts||profile.contact||{};
    const contacts=[...new Set([...(Array.isArray(contact)?contact:Object.values(contact)),profile.email,profile.phone,profile.location].filter(value=>typeof value==='string'&&value.trim()))];
    if(profile.goal)addHeader('求职意向 · '+clean(profile.goal),10.5,'goal',17);
    if(contacts.length)addHeader(contacts.join('  ·  '),9.7,'contact',16);
    const counts=profileCounts(profile);
    const headerBottom=Math.min(674,headerY-3),bodyTop=headerBottom-(counts.length?60:22);
    pages[0].facts=counts.map(([label,count,unit],index)=>{
      const width=523/counts.length;
      const x=36+width*index;
      return {x,y:headerBottom-39,width:width-6,text:count+' '+unit+label};
    });
    pages[0].photo=photo?{...photo,pixelWidth:photo.width,pixelHeight:photo.height,x:50,y:headerBottom+14,width:80,height:104}:null;
    if(!photo)pages[0].push({text:clean(profile.name).slice(-1)||'履',size:36,x:72,y:headerBottom+51,kind:'avatar'});
    const ensurePage=index=>{
      while(pages.length<=index)pages.push([]);
      if(index>0&&!pages[index].some(item=>item.kind==='continuation')){
        pages[index].push({text:clean(profile.name)||'个人简历',size:12,x:photo?76:43,y:794,kind:'continuation'});
        if(photo)pages[index].photo={...photo,pixelWidth:photo.width,pixelHeight:photo.height,x:43,y:778,width:24,height:31};
      }
    };
    function column(x,width){
      let page=0,y=bodyTop;
      const nextPage=()=>{page++;ensurePage(page);y=751;};
      const room=height=>{if(y-height<bottom)nextPage();};
      function text(value,{size=10.5,leading=16.3,kind='body',gap=0,bullet=false,indent=0,keep=0}={}){
        const rows=wrap(clean(value),size,width-indent);
        if(!rows.length)return;
        room(gap+Math.min(rows.length,2)*leading+keep);y-=gap;
        rows.forEach((row,index)=>{
          room(leading);
          pages[page].push({text:row,size,x:x+indent,y,kind,bullet:bullet&&index===0});y-=leading;
        });
      }
      function section(title,keep=34){
        const english={'教育背景':'EDUCATION','技能与证书':'SKILLS','个人简介':'PROFILE','实习与项目经历':'EXPERIENCE'}[title];
        room(44+keep);y-=8;
        if(english){pages[page].push({text:english,size:7.1,x,y,kind:'kicker'});y-=15;}
        pages[page].push({text:title,size:12.2,x,y,kind:'section',ruleWidth:width});y-=25;
      }
      function entry(organization,role,period,details=[]){
        const dateRows=wrap(clean(period),9.2,110),orgRows=wrap(clean(organization)||clean(role),11.2,period?width-116:width);
        const titleRows=Math.max(orgRows.length,dateRows.length);
        const compactHeight=16+titleRows*17+(role?18:0)+details.reduce((height,detail)=>height+wrap(clean(detail),10.5,width-9).length*16.3+3,0);
        // Keep a normal, concise entry together. Oversized edited entries still
        // flow across pages instead of forcing overflow or reducing the font.
        room(compactHeight<=751-bottom?compactHeight:10+titleRows*17+(role?18:0)+(details.length?18:0));y-=8;
        const startY=y;
        orgRows.forEach((row,index)=>pages[page].push({text:row,size:11.2,x,y:startY-index*17,kind:'entry'}));
        dateRows.forEach((row,index)=>pages[page].push({text:row,size:9.2,x:x+width-textWidth(row,9.2),y:startY-index*17,kind:'date'}));
        y-=titleRows*17;
        if(role&&organization)text(role,{kind:'role',leading:17,size:10.5});
        for(const detail of details)text(detail,{bullet:true,indent:9,gap:3});
        y-=8;
      }
      return {text,section,entry};
    }
    const side=column(sideX,sideWidth),main=column(mainX,mainWidth);
    for(const item of deferredHeader){main.section(item.kind==='goal'?'求职意向':item.kind==='contact'?'联系资料':item.kind==='name'?'个人资料':'专业概述');main.text(item.text,{size:10.5,leading:17.2});}
    const education=educationEntries(profile);
    if(education.length){
      side.section('教育背景',40);
      for(const item of education){
        side.text(item.school,{kind:'entry',size:11,leading:17,gap:5,keep:30});
        side.text([item.degree,item.major].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),{size:10.5,leading:16});
        side.text(item.period,{kind:'date',size:9.5,leading:16});
        for(const detail of item.details||[])side.text(detail,{size:10.5,leading:16,gap:4});
        side.text(' ',{gap:9,leading:1});
      }
    }
    if((profile.skills||[]).some(value=>clean(value))){
      side.section('技能与证书',30);
      for(const value of profile.skills)side.text(value,{size:10.5,leading:16.3,gap:6});
    }
    if(profile.summary){main.section('个人简介',35);main.text(profile.summary,{leading:17.2});}
    const experiences=experienceEntries(profile);
    if(experiences.length){
      main.section('实习与项目经历',44);
      for(const item of experiences)main.entry(item.organization,item.role,item.period,item.bullets||[]);
    }
    for(const [index,page]of pages.entries()){
      page.headerBottom=index===0?headerBottom:771;
      page.sideTop=index===0?bodyTop+5:760;
      page.avatar=index===0&&!photo?{x:50,y:headerBottom+14,width:80,height:104}:null;
    }
    return pages;
  }
  const colours={ink:'#252b20',muted:'#636d5f',body:'#3a4535',kicker:'#4b6d36',header:'#edf3e2',sidebar:'#f5f8ef',avatar:'#e1ebd4',rule:'#cdd9c4',bullet:'#5e8549'};
  function pageModel(profile) {
    const raw=layout(profile),pages=raw.map((page,index)=>{
      const rects=[{x:0,y:0,width:595,height:842,fill:'#ffffff'},{x:36,y:page.headerBottom,width:523,height:810-page.headerBottom,fill:colours.header},{x:36,y:65,width:148,height:page.sideTop-65,fill:colours.sidebar}];
      if(page.avatar)rects.push({...page.avatar,fill:colours.avatar});
      const items=page.map(item=>({...item,width:textWidth(item.text,item.size),fill:item.kind==='kicker'?colours.kicker:['section','name','entry','continuation','avatar'].includes(item.kind)?colours.ink:['date','contact'].includes(item.kind)?colours.muted:colours.body,bold:['name','entry','section','continuation','avatar'].includes(item.kind)}));
      const lines=[{x1:43,y1:50,x2:552,y2:50,stroke:'#dbe4d3',width:.5}];
      for(const [index,fact] of (page.facts||[]).entries()){
        const {x,y,width,text}=fact;
        rects.push({x,y,width,height:27,fill:index===1?'#f9f2da':'#eff4e7'});
        items.push({x:x+12,y:y+8,text,size:11,width:textWidth(text,11),fill:colours.kicker,bold:true});
      }
      for(const item of items){if(item.kind==='section')lines.push({x1:item.x,y1:item.y-8,x2:item.x+item.ruleWidth,y2:item.y-8,stroke:colours.rule,width:.55});if(item.bullet)rects.push({x:item.x-8,y:item.y+3,width:2,height:2,fill:colours.bullet});}
      const footer=[{text:`${clean(profile.name)}  |  ${index+1}`,size:8.5,x:43,y:33,kind:'footer',fill:'#636d5f',bold:false},{text:`${index+1} / ${raw.length}`,size:8.5,x:552-textWidth(`${index+1} / ${raw.length}`,8.5),y:33,kind:'footer',fill:'#636d5f',bold:false}].map(item=>({...item,width:textWidth(item.text,item.size)}));
      const images=[];
      if(page.photo){const image=page.photo;
        // The image object retains its natural dimensions separately from its
        // display box, so portrait photographs preserve their aspect ratio.
        const ratio=Math.min(image.width/image.pixelWidth,image.height/image.pixelHeight),w=image.pixelWidth*ratio,h=image.pixelHeight*ratio;
        images.push({dataUrl:image.dataUrl,jpegHex:image.jpegHex,pixelWidth:image.pixelWidth,pixelHeight:image.pixelHeight,x:image.x+(image.width-w)/2,y:image.y+(image.height-h)/2,width:w,height:h});
      }
      return {width:595,height:842,rects,lines,items:[...items,...footer],images};
    });
    return {width:595,height:842,pages};
  }
  function pdfText(profile) {return pageModel(profile).pages.flatMap(page=>page.items.map(item=>item.text)).join('\n');}
  function previewHTML(profile) {
    ensurePreviewFont();
    const model=pageModel(profile);
    const pages=model.pages.map((page,index)=>`<section class="jr-preview-page" aria-label="简历第${index+1}页，共${model.pages.length}页"><svg class="jr-preview-sheet" viewBox="0 0 595 842" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="${escape(profile.name||'个人')}的简历，第${index+1}页" style="font-family:'CareerPath Resume','Noto Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif">${page.rects.map(rect=>`<rect x="${rect.x}" y="${842-rect.y-rect.height}" width="${rect.width}" height="${rect.height}" fill="${rect.fill}"/>`).join('')}${page.lines.map(line=>`<line x1="${line.x1}" y1="${842-line.y1}" x2="${line.x2}" y2="${842-line.y2}" stroke="${line.stroke}" stroke-width="${line.width}"/>`).join('')}${page.images.map(image=>`<image class="jr-resume-photo" aria-label="简历照片" href="${image.dataUrl}" x="${image.x}" y="${842-image.y-image.height}" width="${image.width}" height="${image.height}"/>`).join('')}${page.items.map(item=>`<text x="${item.x}" y="${842-item.y}" font-size="${item.size}" fill="${item.fill}" ${item.bold?`stroke="${item.fill}" stroke-width="0.16" paint-order="stroke"`:''} ${item.width>0?`textLength="${item.width}" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"`:''} xml:space="preserve">${escape(item.text)}</text>`).join('')}</svg><p class="jr-preview-page-label">第 ${index+1} / ${model.pages.length} 页 · 与导出PDF使用同一版式</p></section>`).join('');
    return `<article class="j-resume-paper jr-document jr-paged-preview" aria-label="排版后的简历">${pages}</article>`;
  }
  function toPDF(profile) {
    const pages=pageModel(profile).pages, objects=[];
    const add=source=>{objects.push(source);return objects.length;};
    const catalog=add(''), tree=add('');
    const unicode=`/CIDInit /ProcSet findresource begin 12 dict begin begincmap /CIDSystemInfo << /Registry (Adobe) /Ordering (UCS) /Supplement 0 >> def /CMapName /Adobe-Identity-UCS def /CMapType 2 def 1 begincodespacerange <0000> <FFFF> endcodespacerange 1 beginbfrange <0000> <FFFF> <0000> endbfrange endcmap CMapName currentdict /CMap defineresource pop end end`;
    const cmap=add(`<< /Length ${unicode.length} >>\nstream\n${unicode}\nendstream`);
    const embedded=globalThis.CareerJourneyFont;
    if(!embedded?.fontHex||!embedded?.cidMapHex)throw Error('PDF字体尚未加载完整，请刷新后重试。');
    const fontEncoded=embedded.fontHex+'>';
    const fontStream=add(`<< /Length ${fontEncoded.length} /Length1 ${embedded.fontLength} /Filter [/ASCIIHexDecode /FlateDecode] >>\nstream\n${fontEncoded}\nendstream`);
    const mappingEncoded=embedded.cidMapHex+'>';
    const mappingStream=add(`<< /Length ${mappingEncoded.length} /Filter [/ASCIIHexDecode /FlateDecode] >>\nstream\n${mappingEncoded}\nendstream`);
    const descriptor=add(`<< /Type /FontDescriptor /FontName /${embedded.name} /Flags 4 /FontBBox [${embedded.fontBBox.join(' ')}] /ItalicAngle 0 /Ascent ${embedded.ascent} /Descent ${embedded.descent} /CapHeight ${embedded.capHeight} /StemV 80 /FontFile2 ${fontStream} 0 R >>`);
    const cid=add(`<< /Type /Font /Subtype /CIDFontType2 /BaseFont /${embedded.name} /CIDSystemInfo << /Registry (Adobe) /Ordering (Identity) /Supplement 0 >> /FontDescriptor ${descriptor} 0 R /CIDToGIDMap ${mappingStream} 0 R /DW 1000 /W [32 [${embedded.widths.join(' ')}]] >>`);
    const font=add(`<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type0 /BaseFont /${embedded.name} /Encoding /Identity-H /DescendantFonts [${cid} 0 R] /ToUnicode ${cmap} 0 R >>`);
    const pageIds=[];
    const rgb=colour=>[1,3,5].map(index=>parseInt(colour.slice(index,index+2),16)/255).map(value=>Number(value.toFixed(5))).join(' ');
    for(const [index,page]of pages.entries()) {
      let content=page.rects.map(rect=>`${rgb(rect.fill)} rg ${rect.x} ${rect.y} ${rect.width} ${rect.height} re f\n`).join('')+page.lines.map(line=>`${rgb(line.stroke)} RG ${line.width} w ${line.x1} ${line.y1} m ${line.x2} ${line.y2} l S\n`).join('');
      const imageResources=[];
      for(const [imageIndex,image]of page.images.entries()){
        const encoded=image.jpegHex+'>',imageId=add(`<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width ${image.pixelWidth} /Height ${image.pixelHeight} /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Length ${encoded.length} /Filter [/ASCIIHexDecode /DCTDecode] >>\nstream\n${encoded}\nendstream`),name='Photo'+imageIndex;
        imageResources.push(`/${name} ${imageId} 0 R`);content+=`q ${image.width} 0 0 ${image.height} ${image.x} ${image.y} cm /${name} Do Q\n`;
      }
      for(const item of page.items) {
        const colour=rgb(item.fill),weight=item.bold?'2 Tr 0.16 w':'0 Tr';
        content+=`${colour} rg ${colour} RG BT /F1 ${item.size} Tf ${weight} 1 0 0 1 ${item.x} ${item.y} Tm <${hex(item.text)}> Tj ET\n`;
      }
      const stream=add(`<< /Length ${content.length} >>\nstream\n${content}endstream`);
      pageIds.push(add(`<< /Type /Page /Parent ${tree} 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 595 842] /Resources << /Font << /F1 ${font} 0 R >> ${imageResources.length?`/XObject << ${imageResources.join(' ')} >>`:''} >> /Contents ${stream} 0 R >>`));
    }
    objects[catalog-1]=`<< /Type /Catalog /Pages ${tree} 0 R >>`;
    objects[tree-1]=`<< /Type /Pages /Kids [${pageIds.map(id=>`${id} 0 R`).join(' ')}] /Count ${pageIds.length} >>`;
    let pdf='%PDF-1.4\n%CareerPath\n';const offsets=[0];
    objects.forEach((source,index)=>{offsets.push(pdf.length);pdf+=`${index+1} 0 obj\n${source}\nendobj\n`;});
    const xref=pdf.length;pdf+=`xref\n0 ${objects.length+1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n`;
    for(const offset of offsets.slice(1))pdf+=String(offset).padStart(10,'0')+' 00000 n \n';

    return new TextEncoder().encode(pdf);
  }

/* Extract a likely first-page portrait locally. No face service or image upload. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const identity=()=>[1,0,0,1,0,0];
  const multiply=(a,b)=>[a[0]*b[0]+a[2]*b[1],a[1]*b[0]+a[3]*b[1],a[0]*b[2]+a[2]*b[3],a[1]*b[2]+a[3]*b[3],a[0]*b[4]+a[2]*b[5]+a[4],a[1]*b[4]+a[3]*b[5]+a[5]];
  function candidateBounds(matrix,view){
    const points=[[0,0],[1,0],[0,1],[1,1]].map(([x,y])=>[matrix[0]*x+matrix[2]*y+matrix[4],matrix[1]*x+matrix[3]*y+matrix[5]]);
    const rect=[Math.min(...points.map(p=>p[0])),Math.min(...points.map(p=>p[1])),Math.max(...points.map(p=>p[0])),Math.max(...points.map(p=>p[1]))];
    if(typeof view.convertToViewportRectangle==='function'){
      const converted=view.convertToViewportRectangle(rect);
      return {left:Math.min(converted[0],converted[2]),top:Math.min(converted[1],converted[3]),width:Math.abs(converted[2]-converted[0]),height:Math.abs(converted[3]-converted[1])};
    }
    return {left:rect[0],top:view.height-rect[3],width:rect[2]-rect[0],height:rect[3]-rect[1]};
  }
  function candidatesFor(operatorList,ops,view){
    const candidates=[],stack=[];let matrix=identity();
    if(!operatorList?.fnArray||!operatorList?.argsArray||!view?.width||!view?.height)return candidates;
    const area=view.width*view.height;
    for(let index=0;index<operatorList.fnArray.length;index++){
      const operation=operatorList.fnArray[index],args=operatorList.argsArray[index]||[];
      if(operation===ops.save){stack.push([...matrix]);continue;}
      if(operation===ops.restore){matrix=stack.pop()||identity();continue;}
      if(operation===ops.transform){if(args.length>=6)matrix=multiply(matrix,args);continue;}
      if(operation===ops.paintFormXObjectBegin){stack.push([...matrix]);if(Array.isArray(args[0])&&args[0].length===6)matrix=multiply(matrix,args[0]);continue;}
      if(operation===ops.paintFormXObjectEnd){matrix=stack.pop()||identity();continue;}
      const external=operation===ops.paintImageXObject,inline=operation===ops.paintInlineImageXObject;
      if(!external&&!inline)continue;
      const bounds=candidateBounds(matrix,view),ratio=bounds.width/bounds.height,coverage=bounds.width*bounds.height/area;
      // A small portrait near the top can be suggested. Page scans, backgrounds,
      // wide banners and tiny logos are deliberately excluded.
      if(bounds.width<46||bounds.height<58||ratio<.48||ratio>1.18||coverage<.006||coverage>.15||bounds.top<-.02*view.height||bounds.top+bounds.height>view.height*.54||bounds.left<-.02*view.width||bounds.left+bounds.width>view.width*1.02)continue;
      const item={id:external?String(args[0]):'inline-'+index,inline:inline?args[0]:null,bounds,score:3-Math.abs(ratio-.78)*2-bounds.top/view.height};
      if(!candidates.some(previous=>previous.id===item.id))candidates.push(item);
    }
    return candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
  }
  function objectFor(page,id){
    const objects=id.startsWith('g_')&&page.commonObjs?page.commonObjs:page.objs;
    if(!objects?.get)return Promise.resolve(null);
    try{if(objects.has?.(id))return Promise.resolve(objects.get(id));}catch{/* Wait for the decoding callback below. */}
    return new Promise(resolve=>{
      let settled=false;
      const finish=value=>{if(settled)return;settled=true;clearTimeout(timer);resolve(value||null);};
      const timer=setTimeout(()=>finish(null),1800);
      try{const value=objects.get(id,finish);if(value)finish(value);}catch{finish(null);}
    });
  }
  function toPortrait(image){
    const width=Number(image?.width||image?.bitmap?.width),height=Number(image?.height||image?.bitmap?.height);
    if(!Number.isInteger(width)||!Number.isInteger(height)||width<80||height<80||width*height>8000000)return null;
    const source=document.createElement('canvas');source.width=width;source.height=height;
    const context=source.getContext('2d');if(!context)return null;
    if(image.bitmap)context.drawImage(image.bitmap,0,0,width,height);
    else{
      const input=image.data;if(!input)return null;
      const output=context.createImageData(width,height),rgba=output.data;
      if(image.kind===1){
        const rowBytes=Math.ceil(width/8);if(input.length<rowBytes*height)return null;
        for(let y=0;y<height;y++)for(let x=0;x<width;x++){const value=input[y*rowBytes+(x>>3)]&(128>>(x&7))?255:0,offset=(y*width+x)*4;rgba[offset]=rgba[offset+1]=rgba[offset+2]=value;rgba[offset+3]=255;}
      }else if(image.kind===3||input.length===width*height*4)rgba.set(input);
      else if(image.kind===2||input.length===width*height*3){for(let i=0,j=0;i<input.length;i+=3,j+=4){rgba[j]=input[i];rgba[j+1]=input[i+1];rgba[j+2]=input[i+2];rgba[j+3]=255;}}
      else return null;
      context.putImageData(output,0,0);
    }
    const scale=Math.min(1,480/Math.max(width,height)),canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(width*scale));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(height*scale));
    const result=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!result)return null;
    result.fillStyle='#ffffff';result.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);result.drawImage(source,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    let dataUrl=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.9);
    if(dataUrl.length>512000)dataUrl=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.78);
    if(!/^data:image\/jpeg;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/.test(dataUrl)||dataUrl.length>512000)return null;
    return {dataUrl,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height};
  }
  async function readImageFile(file){
    if(!file||typeof file.arrayBuffer!=='function')throw Error('请选择一张照片。');
    if(!Number.isFinite(file.size)||file.size<=0)throw Error('照片文件为空，请重新选择。');
    if(file.size>8*1024*1024)throw Error('照片超过8MB，请先压缩后再选择。');
    const mime=String(file.type||'').toLowerCase(),name=String(file.name||'');
    if(!/^(?:image\/jpeg|image\/png|image\/webp)$/.test(mime)&&!(/\.(?:jpe?g|png|webp)$/i.test(name)&&!mime))throw Error('请选择JPG、PNG或WebP格式的照片。');
    let image,url;
    try{
      const buffer=await file.arrayBuffer();
      if(buffer.byteLength>8*1024*1024)throw Error('照片超过8MB，请先压缩后再选择。');
      const blob=new Blob([buffer],{type:mime||(/\.png$/i.test(name)?'image/png':/\.webp$/i.test(name)?'image/webp':'image/jpeg')});
      if(typeof createImageBitmap==='function')image=await createImageBitmap(blob);
      else{
        if(typeof Image!=='function'||!URL?.createObjectURL)throw Error('浏览器暂时无法读取照片，请使用新版Chrome、Edge或Safari。');
        url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        image=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const value=new Image();value.onload=()=>resolve(value);value.onerror=()=>reject(Error('照片未能读取，请换一张JPG或PNG。'));value.src=url;});
      }
      const width=Number(image.width||image.naturalWidth),height=Number(image.height||image.naturalHeight);
      if(!width||!height||width*height>40000000)throw Error('照片像素过大或尺寸异常，请缩小后重试。');
      const scale=Math.min(1,512/Math.max(width,height)),canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(width*scale));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(height*scale));
      const context=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!context)throw Error('浏览器暂时无法处理照片，请换用其他浏览器。');
      context.fillStyle='#ffffff';context.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);context.drawImage(image,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      let dataUrl=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.92);if(dataUrl.length>512000)dataUrl=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.78);
      if(!/^data:image\/jpeg;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/.test(dataUrl)||dataUrl.length>512000)throw Error('照片未能压缩，请选择尺寸更小的图片。');
      return {dataUrl,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height};
    }catch(error){if(/[\u4e00-\u9fff]/.test(error?.message||''))throw error;throw Error('照片未能读取，请换一张JPG、PNG或WebP。');}
    finally{image?.close?.();if(url)URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}
  }
  async function extract(page,pdfjs){
    if(typeof document==='undefined'||typeof document.createElement!=='function'||!page?.getOperatorList||!page?.getViewport||!pdfjs?.OPS)return null;
    try{
      // PDF.js uses the Map upsert proposal for its operator-list cache. Older
      // Safari and offline Node validation hosts do not yet provide it.
      if(typeof Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed!=='function')Object.defineProperty(Map.prototype,'getOrInsertComputed',{configurable:true,writable:true,value:function(key,callback){if(this.has(key))return this.get(key);if(typeof callback!=='function')throw new TypeError('A callback is required');const value=callback(key);this.set(key,value);return value;}});
      const choices=candidatesFor(await page.getOperatorList(),pdfjs.OPS,page.getViewport({scale:1}));
      if(!choices.length)return null;
      // Several equally plausible portraits need a person to choose; avoid
      // silently using an arbitrary colleague or a grid of headshots.
      if(choices.length>1&&choices[0].score-choices[1].score<.15)return null;
      const choice=choices[0],image=choice.inline||await objectFor(page,choice.id);
      return toPortrait(image);
    }catch{return null;}
  }
  globalThis.CareerJourneyResumePhoto=Object.freeze({extract,candidatesFor,readImageFile});
})();

/* PDF.js fingerprints need this newer API in both the page and its worker.
 * Keep the compatibility shim local; do not replace a browser's native API. */
if (typeof Uint8Array.prototype.toHex !== 'function') {
  const typedArrayPrototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(Uint8Array.prototype);
  const typedArrayName = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(typedArrayPrototype, Symbol.toStringTag).get;
  const values = Uint8Array.prototype.values;
  const hex = Array.from({length: 256}, (_, byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'));

  Object.defineProperty(Uint8Array.prototype, 'toHex', {
    configurable: true,
    writable: true,
    value: function toHex() {
      if (typedArrayName.call(this) !== 'Uint8Array') {
        throw new TypeError('Uint8Array.prototype.toHex requires a Uint8Array');
      }
      // The intrinsic iterator validates detached/out-of-bounds buffers and
      // visits this view only, including a subarray with a nonzero byteOffset.
      const bytes = values.call(this);
      let result = '';
      for (const byte of bytes) result += hex[byte];
      return result;
    }
  });
}
